Hi Logan,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the initial questionnaire. We reviewed the sections for AWS/Azure/GCP marketplace listing and there are a few clarification items that will block procurement unless we have firm answers or evidence. Listing the asks below so we can map responsibilities on your side: 

1) Tenant isolation & multi-tenant model
   - Do you provide per-tenant encryption keys (customer KMS) on Dedicated/Private deployments?
   - If using Hosted API, what isolation guarantees exist and what evidence can be supplied?

2) Billing & fulfillment flow
   - For AWS and Azure marketplace options, do you support SaaS Metering versus private billing? Which paths are recommended for enterprise licensing?

3) Commercial docs & invoicing
   - Sample EULA / SOW language referencing marketplaces and rev-share (we need an example).

4) Security artifacts
   - SOC 2 Type II, pen test summary, and audit-log retention policy (we will attach our security questionnaire).

5) Data residency & export controls
   - Can you restrict model serving to specific cloud regions and provide proof?

6) SLA & support escalation
   - Standard SLA, on-call escalation matrix, and the ability to include response commitments in the marketplace listing.

7) Marketplace-specific paperwork
   - Any DocuSign templates or listing manifests you require from us to proceed on AWS/Azure/GCP?

We attached our RFI (NovaCloud_RFI_v3.xlsx) with line-item cross-references. Would you be able to provide a consolidated evidence pack by EOD Friday (6 Nov)? If not, please propose a timeline.

Appreciate your help — our procurement team is the blocker today.

Best,

Logan / team — I filled the security sections in the draft and attached the summary artifacts. Key points: 

- SOC 2 Type II: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II for the hosted control plane and inference runtime; encrypted logs and audit trails are retained for 13 months by default. Evidence: SOC2_Type2_summary.pdf (redacted).

- Encryption & KMS: For Private/Dedicated we support customer-managed keys (CMKs) via AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault / GCP KMS. For Hosted API, we use provider-managed keys; customers can opt for dedicated instances with CMK requirement.

- Tenant isolation: Logical multi-tenancy for hosted tiers with strict namespace isolation; Dedicated provides VM/GPU tenancy and network isolation. For regulated workloads, Private deploys in-customer VPC with no cross-tenant access. Network diagram attached.

- Logging & audit: Real-time request-level audit logs, immutable append-only storage. Retention configurable up to 7 years for enterprise plans; default 13 months.

- Pen test: Annual third-party pen test (summary available); full reports provided under NDA.

- Data export & residency: Customers can pin regions per deployment. For marketplace listings we surface region coverage and ISO region codes in the listing metadata.

Notes: I left comments in procurement_answers_draft.docx for items where legal input is required (EULA/SOW language and revenue share).

Attachments: SOC2_Type2_summary.pdf, network_arch_diagram.png

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_Type2_summary.pdf] [Attachment: network_arch_diagram.png]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Elaine — quick operational notes on marketplace fulfillment and billing flows (AWS/Azure/GCP):

1) AWS Marketplace
   - SaaS Metering: supports per-unit metering; Redwood can surface metering data via the AWS Metering API. Best when you want usage-based billing and reseller handling.
   - AMI/Private Image: For Dedicated/Private deployments we can provide an AMI/Helm chart; procurement is via direct contract and marketplace listing is optional.

2) Azure Marketplace
   - Works with SaaS offers or VM images. Metered offers require a specific telemetry contract. Azure supports reseller-managed billing if you opt-in.

3) GCP Marketplace
   - Offers metered SaaS and private images. GCP Marketplace tends to have longer lead time for custom invoice flows.

Recommended approach for NovaCloud:
   - Short term (fastest): Publish an AWS SaaS Metering listing and use direct contract for commercial terms (SOW + invoicing).
   - Mid term: Prepare an AMI/Helm fulfillment option for Dedicated customers who need tenant isolation and CMKs.
   - Long term: Full multi-cloud listing once the marketplace metering hooks and billing reconciliations are automated.

I've attached a fulfillment matrix comparing latency/ops/responsibility across marketplaces. Also included: a DocuSign template link for standard marketplace manifests.

Attachments: marketplace_fulfillment_matrix.xlsx
Related: https://docusign.com/templates/redwood-marketplace-listing

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Partner Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: marketplace_fulfillment_matrix.xlsx]
